name: pr-review-ui
description: PR reviews as numbered points in the conversation; picking a point opens its code beside it in terminal-browser (the GitHub page, lines highlighted), or in a code pane.

codeView.title: Where review code shows
codeView.description: auto opens each point's code in terminal-browser when it is installed (the GitHub page, lines highlighted) and falls back to this mod's code pane; browser always uses terminal-browser; pane always uses the code pane.

ghPath.title: gh executable
ghPath.description: The GitHub CLI the review uses to read the PR diff. Use a full path if gh is not on the PATH Claude Code sees.

autoReview.title: Review when you paste a PR link
autoReview.description: When a prompt says review and holds a GitHub PR link, ask for the review in the points format without needing the slash command.
